clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November with your father working late most nights, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. The shifts in these months belong together as the family's reactions to the new child and the strain it brought, each one's trouble near another's.
